summary: Frontend-only verification of Laddu Gopal blessing corner visibility across desktop (1920x900), tablet (768x900), and mobile (375x800). Corner is visible, correctly positioned in the top-right, image loads with naturalWidth=362, blessing text renders on all viewports, and rest of Hero content (heading, subtitle, Apply Now button) is intact.

Consider slightly smaller max-width or moving to top:80 on mobile if aesthetics matter — functionally not broken.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Laddu Gopal corner visibility bug is fully resolved. Corner renders on all 3 viewport sizes with image loaded (naturalWidth=362). If user still reports 'don't see Gopu's pic', check browser cache — no code-level issue remains.
